# CHMReaderLight

A lightweight offline CHM reader and library for macOS.

## What It Does

CHMReaderLight provides a library-first workflow, searchable table of contents, body search, reading history, zoom, text encoding controls, and local-only CHM reading on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

## Trust Notes

- No telemetry, accounts, cloud sync, or hosted document storage.
- CHM-authored scripts and network access are blocked.
- Release archives include SHA-256 checksum files.
- Current builds are not Apple-notarized.
